description: Scratch fused FP32 and FP16-HVP/refinement continuation; both rejected as a general solver because exact 3-way rank null-space was not preserved.
limitations: Single exploratory runs; timings not controlled repeats or production comparisons.

The mixed-rankgeneral41 run uses the v1 fixture with many additional exact duplicated column pairs; after changing three of those columns, the generic pairwise nullspace metric is inapplicable, but its separately reported three_column_null_ratio refers to an exact validated 3-column relation and is valid.
The FP32 noisy rankgeneral runs use a clean three-column relation, no duplicated half-column fixture, and independent original float64 scoring.
Three-way relation and fp16 mismatch rows are constructed and verified by the archived driver; retained source hashes were checked during each run.
FP32 C=1e6 output continued successfully in gradient/progress terms but its nullspace coefficient ratio grew to 0.999664; this is a numerical correctness failure, not a timing optimization.
Mixed ill uses 48 half-HVP + 1 full residual + 48 half-HVP; its final loss still exceeds the tight objective reference by ~1.08e-5.
The no-intercept and native sketched bridge were not covered by this exploratory panel.
tight-reference.json contains cases whose reference gradients exceed 1e-7; those must not be treated as valid strict references.
